commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-mpc-matrix.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --single-branch --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "2ad2177943c4e3a50a4ad094bf939600f1ce14bf"
printf 'MPC_MATRIX_SOURCE_SHA|%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -m compileall -q tools/ml/mpc
python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_mpc_devices tests.test_mpc_optimizer_mock tests.test_mpc_baselines tests.test_mpc_device_responses tests.test_mpc_physics_integration tests.test_mpc_lab_observability tests.test_mpc_shadow_contract tests.test_mpc_scenario_catalog
echo 'MPC_MATRIX_UNIT_AND_R4|PASS'
set +e
python3 -m tools.ml.mpc.scenario_matrix --steps 12 --step-s 60 --seeds 1729 1730 --output-dir "$WORK/results" > "$WORK/matrix.log" 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
if test "$RC" -ne 0 -a "$RC" -ne 2; then cat "$WORK/matrix.log"; printf 'MPC_MATRIX_TOOL_ERROR|%s\n' "$RC"; exit 73; fi
python3 - "$WORK/results/manifest.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys,collections
m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert m['source_commit']=='2ad2177943c4e3a50a4ad094bf939600f1ce14bf'
assert m['synthetic_uncalibrated'] and not m['physical_validation_with_real_data']
assert len(m['results'])==66, (len(m['results']),m['failed_executions'])
assert not m['failed_executions'],m['failed_executions']
counts=collections.Counter((r['policy'],r['quality']['status']) for r in m['results'])
print('MPC_MATRIX_STATUS_COUNTS|'+json.dumps({p+'_'+s:n for (p,s),n in counts.items()},sort_keys=True))
by={(r['scenario'],r['seed'],r['policy']):r['quality'] for r in m['results']}
for scenario in [v['name'] for v in m['scenarios']]:
 for seed in m['config']['seeds']:
  a=by[scenario,seed,'mpc'];b=by[scenario,seed,'threshold'];h=by[scenario,seed,'hysteresis']
  print('MPC_MATRIX_CASE|'+json.dumps({'scenario':scenario,'seed':seed,
   'mpc_status':a['status'],'threshold_status':b['status'],'hysteresis_status':h['status'],
   'mpc_temperature_mae_c':a['temp_mae_c'],
   'threshold_temperature_mae_c':b['temp_mae_c'],
   'mpc_rh_mae_pp':a['rh_mae_pp'],
   'mpc_co2_mae_ppm':a['co2_mae_ppm'],
   'mpc_fallback_steps':a['fallback_steps'],
   'mpc_safety_violations':a['safety_violations']},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
print('MPC_MATRIX_DIAGNOSTIC_GATE|'+m['quality_gate'])
PY
printf 'MPC_MATRIX_CLI_GATE_EXIT|%s\n' "$RC"
